arcs.title: Middle East Supply Shock: The Crude Surge
arcs.summary: Iran-Israel tensions pushed WTI from $89 to $96.41 as the market priced in a Hormuz supply premium. MCX crude crossed ₹9,000 for the first time this year — HPCL and IndiGo are repricing exposure in real time.
arcs.outcome: MCX Crude retreated from the ₹9,000 key level back to ₹7,615 as the geopolitical supply premium from Iran-Israel tensions dissipated and market participants unwound their bullish exposure.

arcs.title: Iran-US Peace Talks Collapse: Safe-Haven Gold Rebounds
arcs.summary: Iran publicly rejects key US peace conditions, reversing diplomatic optimism and triggering a flight-to-safety rally in gold while crude remains under pressure.
